name: CSI-Bench
summary: Large-scale in-the-wild benchmark spanning seven WiFi sensing tasks, commercial edge hardware, real homes, and continuous natural activity.

hardware.platform: Commercial routers and IoT edge devices

settings.scenario: Homes, offices, and public indoor areas; in the wild

original.license: CC BY-NC 4.0 on Kaggle; repository text should be checked per release

standardization.notes: Task-aware time profile: BreathingDetection uses 10 Hz; all other sensing tasks use 100 Hz. Window length is chosen per task, the full recording is segmented without dropping data, and native subcarrier/Tx/Rx sizes are preserved unless requested otherwise.

collection.device: Commercial routers and IoT edge devices (Broadcom, Qualcomm, MediaTek, Espressif, NXP)
collection.distance: In-the-wild homes/offices; proximity task uses 0.5–3.5 m
collection.scenario_labels: Difficulty settings: easy · medium · hard (where provided by the official splits)
collection.sampling_rate_hz: Task view: 10 Hz for BreathingDetection; 100 Hz for other tasks (recorded as an assumption when the source rate is absent)
collection.clip_length: Flexible by task; full recordings are split into consecutive task-specific windows
collection.scenario: Homes, offices, and public indoor areas; in the wild
